_about: Henry Martyn Baird (1832-1906), historian of the French Reformed Church: History of the Rise of the Huguenots of France (New York: Scribner, 1879, 2 vols), The Huguenots and Henry of Navarre (1886, 2 vols), The Huguenots and the Revocation of the Edict of Nantes (1895, vol. 1; vol. 2 pending), and Theodore Beza, the Counsellor of the French Reformation (New York and London: Putnam, 1899). Volume numbers read off each title page. Named henry-baird so other Bairds cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
